name: backend-feishu-stream-stop
about: Independent formal Feishu stop scope: actual stream inbound/model/final reply followed by actual reaction DELETE triggers fixture edit enabled:false in isolated config. Existing serve until exact adapter hot-reload complete log is the barrier; only then formal WS observer executes builtin nonce-Ping probe of the original exact WS. TS must prove matching Pong leak, Rust must prove old socket close. Timeout is failure. No process-exit cleanup proof, no normal-scene mutation; requires E0 fixed TS calibration.
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
proxy:
  url: http://127.0.0.1:38413
  noProxy: 127.0.0.1,localhost
adapters:
  feishu:
    enabled: true
    appId: cli_0123456789abcdef
    appSecret: feishu-local-secret
    connectionMode: stream
